info.title: Biblioteca Reader - public API
info.description: Everything a browser may call on this origin. biblioteca-server and biblioteca-nestjs are never reachable from the internet directly - this reader backend is the only bridge, and every /api/** route below (bar the raw /api/server-content/* content passthrough) is an explicit, individually-registered proxy (see server.ts), never a wildcard forward, and shared by both upstreams (no prefix distinguishes which one a given path actually goes to - that is server.ts's business, not this contract's). The biblioteca-server-backed entries' shapes are pulled live from its own spec by this file's generator (scripts/build-openapi-public.mjs) - only their EXISTENCE here, not their shape, is hand-curated.

get.description: retrieves TeiElemDto information for a given path, i.e. /alecsandri/versuri

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.
